nom: Naked Sundays SPF50 Golden Glow Shimmer Sunscreen Mist

avis.texte: I received an email from Naked Sundays about the launch of this new spray. I have been using the original spray for over two years. I always have at least two full size bottles and two travel sizes. The travel sizes are great because you can refill them and great for my gym bag and liquid TSA travel bag. So, I have used this spray twice and it is exactly the same as the original. The difference is it smell a bit fruity. No extra glow, nor is there any glitter. This is my opinion and others may feel differently. I use the spray daily along with the gel cream. They are my two favorite products from Naked Sundays.
I love how amazing this product works. It gives the perfect amounts of coverage while also leaving some shimmer on your skin. Perfect for either a beach day or a casual day.

The Golden Glow Shimmer Mist Setting Spray is a very fine mist that's super versatile, I think it's perfect for going over makeup or touching up on sunscreen on a day by the water! I also used it just to give my arms a bit of a glow and as a base under makeup which gave a great subtle glow from underneath. It isn't sticky, love it for a daily sunscreen touch-up and love that it's SPF50. It also smells amazing, not overpowering or chemical like most sunscreens. The glitter is just the right amount that adds a nice glow with a bit of fine sparkles and looks SO cute. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm a beauty guru who loves trying out all of the latest beauty products from hair, skincare, and makeup! I was so dang excited to get my hands on the Naked Sundays golden glow shimmer mist! I really loved this product, it sprays evenly and is very lightweight. It gives you this incredibly beautiful shimmery glow! I have acne prone skin, I love that this didn't break me out! I also really appreciate the fact it has spf in it. The size seems kinda small but that's okay. One thing I'm not a big fan of is the smell it has. Was a little hard for me to bare with at first. It truly leaves the skin feeling hydrated and looking kissed! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Mist Setting Spray SPF50 has been my go-to when I want that dewy, lit-from-within finish and sun protection in one step. It gives the prettiest golden shimmer but nothing chunky or glittery, just a soft glow that catches the light so nicely. I love how lightweight it feels, doesn't mess up my makeup, and actually refreshes everything instead of making it look cakey. Plus, the fact that it's SPF 50 makes it perfect for reapplying sunscreen throughout the day without ruining your look. It's giving glowy skin, protected skin, and effortless summer vibes all in one *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: My Skin Smells Good And Has A Golden Glow
avis.texte: My name is Michele and I am a Beauty Expert in my 30's with combination, fair skin. The Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Glitter Mist Setting Spray Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Sunscreen is my new favorite sunscreen. This amazing Sunscreen Spray smells so good I can't get enough. It has a sweet, fruity Watermelon and Patented PENTAVITIN Kakadu Plum scent. It's the perfect scent for Spring and Summer. I love its shiny golden and silver spray bottle and its purple spray applicator. This 2.53 fluid ounce bottle is the perfect size for travel as it can fit in a purse, tote or travel bag . I love how easy it is to apply this sunscreen to your body. Just shake it up and spray it on your face, arms, legs, chest and anywhere else the sun kisses your body. I would recommend this to anyone who wants a delicious smelling SPF 50 Sunscreen that is easy to apply, doubles as a setting spray for makeup and adds a nice little glitter to your skin too. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Naked Sunday golden glow shimmer setting spray is best for the soft , glowy and luminous glass skin finish. It instantly add the shimmery glow to the skin. The texture of the product is airy . It's so light weight formula and it doesn't make the skin greasy or sticky . I love to use in the beach time and day outing . The ingredients are clean and vegan and safe to use on all types of skin . The sweet scent is so amazingly beautiful. Love to carry without need to wear product with SPF. It's travel friendly which means of if I need the reapplication and it's easy to use . Love it . I received this product as a part of education promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I live in a place that gets 300+ days of sunshine, I do not take my sun care lightly. When I look for sun care products, products that double up are such an easy way to keep protected. Naked Sundays did a fabulous job with their new Golden Glow Shimmer Mist! This spray gets a gold star coming in at SPF 50. The mist itself smells delicious, with nostalgic sweet fruity notes. The packaging is chic and easy to use. After applying this mist leaves your skin sparkling and ready to take on the suns rays. Overall this sunscreen shimmer mist is great. The coverage is dependable and the shimmer is such a fun way to add a little extra to the day. I would highly recommend! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have never been so excited to try out a product before. I've heard such great things about this brand and I love the packaging. It is super adorable. It feels nice in my hand very shiny and eye-catching. The sunscreen itself is a light mist with a pump. It has the most subtle amount of glimmer. I never felt so pretty wearing an SPF before you get more than sun protection with this you get the experience of looking and feeling your best. The smell is amazing. It's almost like a light coconut scent very different than the SPF that I have used previously they do not smell good at all. I would definitely re-purchase the Golden Glow shimmer mist again. . *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I had heard so much about this product from a girl friend and finally got to try it out myself! I absolutely love the glowy finish it gives you!! It does not make me feel greasy or sweaty AT all, instead gives an effortless glow. Makes me feel like it should be summertime already... I cannot WAIT to use this in the summer going out to dinner with my gals and shimmering away with this! SMell is nothing crazy and the texture is light and airy. Overall recommend!

Golden Glow Shimmer Mist Setting Spray SPF50+ instantly caught my attention with its cool bottle. I loved the design the moment I picked it up. The name clearly reflects what the product delivers, which made it easy for me to understand its benefits right away. As summer approached, I was looking for a multitasking product that combines skincare, sun protection, and makeup setting, and this one truly checks all the boxes.I really enjoy the scent when I spray it, and the mist feels lightweight on my skin. It layers beautifully over makeup without smudging or leaving any sticky residue. What I love most is the dewy glow it gives, with no white cast, making my skin look fresh and radiant.I'm so glad I gave it a try, now it's a staple in my bag wherever I go. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was so excited to try this Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Mist Setting Spray SPF50. The nozzle looks like the product would comes out like an aerosol spray. However this is a lovely mist spray. If there is a scent I do not notice one. I do notice it leaves behind this gorgeous, shimmery gold glitter. It is hard to capture the true sparkling goodness of this through the film. It definitely elevates the look plus gives you the added bonus of sunscreen protection. I cannot wait to see if this will come out in different shades of shimmers. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Golden Glow Shimmer Mist Setting Spray with SPF50 is such a cool product. It takes skincare to makeup which is always a feature I love and appreciate. After applying makeup it's easy to use the spray and seal in not only your look but also add additional spf protection- which we all know means less potential effects from the sun that can cause aging. It did not provide a white cast but rather is a shimmery glow that looks dewy/hydrated. The spray bottle is also really easy to use, and provides a fine mist for ideal coverage. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Love the ease of use and how quickly it dries
avis.texte: I enjoy the ease of use of this, it's an easy spray on SPF that gives a nice glow to the skin. It has a very nice sweet watermelon/sunscreen scent that I think was very interesting. I like that the mist wasn't too crazy or too little. It was just perfect and it dried down really quickly.SPF is a really important thing to wear year-round so I love the ease of use of this one. The packaging is very nice and has a cool look to it, but I'm always worried more so about the product and how well it works.And since SPF isn't every day need I very much like this and would definitely recommend it. I received as a part of an educational promotion but I always give my honest opinionIf I had to give any type of feedback to anything that somebody might not like it could be the scent because of it being a sweet scent with a mix of the sunscreen smell some people might not like it, but I didn't mind. It's not an overpowering scent that sticks around. My absolute favorite part is how easy it is to use and how quickly it dries. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have been looking forward to trying this brand for a while now and it definitely didn't disappoint. More recently I've been looking into the best ways to incorporate spf into my daily routine and this light weight spray makes that effortless! I love how light and gentle it is on my skin. It doesn't leave you feeling greasy and has just the right hint of shimmer to give you a gorgeous glow! The scent is also light and airy and give you a definitely summer feel. I can't wait to use this product more and although I received this as a part of an educational promotion I'd definitely repurchase and recommend to my family and friends. So if you're looking for a gentle spf mist that's good for you most definitely check this one out!! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

SPF is a must have in my daily routine. The Golden Glow Shimmer mist is the perfect last step in my routine to secure protection on my face. It is a non greasy formula and the "glitter" in it is in great taste because it just adds a natural glow rather than a full on glitter look. The size of the spray is perfect for being on the go when you need a touchup from daily activities. I also really like to use this on a tattoo I have on my hand since it gets so much exposure to sun while I drive. The scent is also really nice because it is light and does not smell like your typical SPF. It has this very light fruity scent from the watermelon. Definitely a must have! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am absolutely obsessed with the new Naked Sundays SPF 50 Golden Shimmer Glow Spray! It gives my skin an incredible, radiant, sun-kissed glow that looks naturally luminous and healthy without feeling greasy, sticky, or heavy. The subtle shimmer catches the light beautifully, making your skin look alive in sunlight. It's lightweight, sprays evenly, smells amazing, and provides high SPF protection, making it perfect for summer days, beach trips, outdoor events, or just glowing around town. I'll definitely be using this all season!(Product was received as part of an educational promotion) *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was really excited to try this spray, and it's honestly such a clever way to handle reapplying sunscreen over makeup without smudging my foundation. The mist is incredibly fine and light, the glitter is really just a slight, subtle sheen that gives a nice little glow rather than looking like chunky sparkles. It feels super cooling and hydrating the second you spray it—the watermelon and hyaluronic acid make it such a refreshing pick-me-up on a hot afternoon. It definitely delivers on that radiant, luminous look if that's what you're after. Just use less and pat in if you tend to have oily skin like me. The scent is mild and actually pleasant, so you don't have to deal with that typical harsh chemical sunscreen smell. Since it's a mist, I just use it as a quick, convenient way to top up my SPF over my makeup throughout the day, and it's been a really handy addition to my routine. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As a Beauty Enthusiast and a Skincare Lover, SPF is always essential for me, and lately I've been using this shimmer mist and I'm really loving it. It gives a soft, natural glow that looks beautiful in the sun without being too shiny. The texture is very light and doesn't feel sticky or heavy on the skin. I also love that it has SPF 50, which makes it perfect for me since I love good sun protection. It's super easy to reapply during the day and has no white cast, which I love. When using it on the face, I normally apply it with my hands instead of spraying directly to protect my eyes, I recommend doing this as well. Overall, it's a great product and has become my new favorite for everyday use. This shimmer wins me over. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm obsessed with this setting spray! It gives the prettiest golden glow without looking heavy or glittery just a soft, luminous finish. I also love that it doubles as SPF 50, making it perfect for reapplying throughout the day while keeping my makeup looking fresh It feels super lightweight, hydrating, and gives that effortless "glassy" summer skin in just a few sprays. This product was gifted to me by Naked Sundays. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Im a big fan of this sunscreen. Ive been using it for a week now out in the sun gardening and it works beautifully. First off it smells fantastic. Doesnt have the sunscreen smell like most sunscreens do. It leaves behind a radiant glow. Not chunky glitter. Just illuminating pigments. Leaving behind a pretty glow. I haven't gotten an inch of sunburn and I've been out in direct sun light. I love that there's no white cast. Its such a pain dealing with white cast. I reapply every two hours like the bottle says. No sunburn. No redness. Doesn't make the skin feel greasy or oily. Dries down nicely. I will definitely be purchasing again. Feels safe wearing it. It also has some pretty neat ingredients like watermelon and kakadu plums. I would highly recommend this sunscreen for anyone looking for a sunscreen with no white cast and that gives you a beautiful glow. Gifted by Sunday Skin for my honest opinion! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using this sunscreen for about a week now, and I have to say, it's absolutely amazing! Normally I can't stand the smell of sunscreen, but this smells like fruity sunshine! The sprayer is SO fine and leaves a wonderful, light mist on your skin. I attached a picture of the finish on the back of my hand- you can clearly see the added glow it gives. This is perfect for someone like me with super dry skin. Overall, this is a 10/10 sunscreen for me and I will continue to use this all summer! I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This product is so useful! I am always looking for a way to apply spf with makeup and I love being able to combine the two. Daily spf is incredibly important to me. The Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Mist setting spray SPF 50 is exactly what I needed to get excited about applying sunscreen. I've been trying to increase my consistency with body sunscreen since I am diligent about applying face SPF daily, but not so much the rest of my body. It doesn't transfer to my clothes which I was worried about. Really enjoying the formula and can't wait to use it throughout the hot summer. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Naked Sundays for the win with this one! I love that it's a mist which makes it super easy for application. The mist dispenses nicely in a light mist which I love cause I am not a fan of getting drenched when applying products. It really does leave a beautiful glow to the skin without it looking or feeling greasy; one thousand bonus points for this! I also really like that it's an SPF because any way to incorporate sun protection into my routine is always and plus and this makes it incredibly easy to do. I highly recommend this one. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This naked Sunday Golden Glow Shimmer Mist sunscreen top up spray SPF 50, smells amazing! the sprayer is so good! it is waterproof, it is so glowy, and smells like summertime! the Shimmer is very subtle if there's any at all to be honest. But that's okay I didn't want it for the Shimmer, I wanted it for the SPF. I have tattoos all over my body and I need to put sunscreen on them so they don't fade, and this works great. Again it smells great, it's a dry spray so it doesn't feel greasy, doesn't look greasy, it's good and a great product! I received it as a promotion to write my honest review and that was my honest review. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I like this shimmer mist because it protects my skin from the sun and I can see small specks of glitter over my makeup even though it's very hard to notice. This mist is very lightweight which unfortunately makes it harder to spot the specks of glitter over your makeup even if you spray a very generous amount on. I found that using the shimmer mist over my arms made the glitter stand out stronger and brighter which I enjoyed better. With the glitter, the spray itself gives off a strong smell of sunscreen after spraying it on but it goes away after a couple of minutes. In addition to spraying the mist over my makeup, I found that it made my skin feel dry and tight which concerned me for a bit but fortunately enough the feeling went away as the mist settled on my skin. Overall, this shimmer mist is a cute topper for your makeup that not only adds glam to your face but protects your skin from the sun! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am really enjoying this spf shimmer mist so far. The pump sprays in a very wide and fine mist, that covers a lot of surface area quickly and easily. It dries down in about 5 to 10 seconds. This is enough time to rub it in or around a bit, but not so long that you are waiting on it to dry. Once it has dried you cannot feel it on your skin at all. It is not sticky or dry feeling. It has a light scent. I presume it is the plum and watermelon, but it just comes across as a slightly sweet "fruity" to me with a moderate undertone of something chemical. This is also gone as soon as it dries. I love that the shimmer is a true shimmer and not a glitter. This gives it a more subtle glowing from within type of look that is beautiful! We haven't had a whole lot of sun here since I received it, so I cannot honestly say how well it works as an SPF, but I will be taking it to my daughter's end of season cheer event in Orlando at the end of the month and I have high hopes! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love this Naked Sundays Golden Glimmer SPF spray. I like that it is effective with an SPF of 50 but also adds a pretty glimmer to the skin.The bottle is great. It sprays really well without clumps or product. It gives an even spray of glimmer.The scent is great. I usually don't love the scent of SPF products but this smells good and it's not too strong.The golden shimmer is just the perfect amount. It leaves a slight sheen and not large clumps of glitter that stand out a lot.Overall, I really enjoyed this setting spray and will definitely continue using it. And I would recommend it. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am really loving this Golden Glow Shimmer Mist Setting Spray SPF50. I love the sun protecting properties and it protects my skin from the harmful UV and sun rays. I loke how gentle this mist feels, as well as the formula. As someone who has dry sensitive skin, I was impressed to see no irritations from this product. I can't wait to use this product over the Summer and it will be one of my go to for vacation. I received this product complimentary in exchange of my honest review . *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love the concept that this is a must because it makes it super easy to reapply my sunscreen / spf throughout the day. And it makes it easier to apply it over makeup so that it does not interfere with it and because it is a setting spray it helps keep my makeup in place all day which is great. Love the concept *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is the first spf setting spray I've seen and I absolutely love it. Instead of the normal chemical smell a lot of setting sprays have, this one has a very pleasant tropical drink scent. The finish feels a bit sticky upon first application but isn't noticeable after it full dries down. The shimmer to the formula is subtle but gives a nice glow effect. It isn't the most firm hold setting spray but for everyday use on light makeup it works wonderfully. The added sun protection is amazing, especially when I always forget to put on sunscreen. Amazing product I would highly recommend. The picture used shows the setting spray on my arm to better showcase the shimmer. This product was received as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've really been loving the Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Mist and have been using it every time I go out. It gives such a pretty glow that looks amazing when the light hits my skin. It never looks glittery or too sparkly, it's just a radiant finish that makes skin look dewy. I especially love using it on my shoulders, décolleté, and arms so that I can get a natural, sun-kissed look. My skin can be a little dry and dull so this mist gives it a boost and makes it look much more hydrated. I've also been using it as a highlighter on my face. I like to spray a bit on my hands and then dab it on my cheeks because it adds a gorgeous, high-shine "wet look" so my face appears healthier.The formula is very lightweight and feels refreshing to mist on my skin. It's not sticky or greasy, which makes it easy to reapply as needed throughout the day. The fragrance gives me summer vibes because it has a hint of watermelon, but it's not overpowering. In addition to the shimmer effect, the mist has nourishing ingredients that leave my skin feeling soft and smooth. This is a huge bonus for me since I get the glow combined with the hyrdation benefits.This mist has become a staple in my routine because it's simple to use and always makes me look luminous. If you want something that gives a glass-skin effect for both your body and face, I highly recommend trying this mist! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I really like this Naked Sundays spf50 sunscreen. This is a lightweight, spray mist. Comes out evenly and perfectly.. Provides the right amount of sunscreen protection without any heaviness, tackiness, or white residue. Not messy or greasy at all.Smells good as well. I really enjoyed this.Love the unique formula, great control of the spray and a scent that is very nice. Application is not greasy and no white residue, very absorbent. A definite must try. I received this as part of an educational promotion but all thoughts and reviews are my honest opinion *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been really impressed with the Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Mist SPF 50. It's such a convenient way to reapply sunscreen throughout the day without messing up makeup. Obsessed with the glow this gives. The Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Setting Spray SPF 50 is the perfect mix of skincare and makeup. It sets my makeup beautifully while adding the most stunning golden shimmer like a soft, sun-kissed radiance without looking chunky or glittery. The mist is ultra-fine, so it layers easily over makeup without disturbing it, and I love that it gives SPF 50 protection for easy reapplication throughout the day. It feels lightweight, hydrating, and never greasy, with zero white cast. Perfect for vacations, summer days, or anytime you want that glowy, dewy finish with added sun protection. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Application & FinishOne of the biggest wins for me is how gentle the formula is. When I sprayed close to my eyelids by accident, my eyes didn't get irritated at all. It works great on top of my sunscreen without making it pill, and most importantly, it didn't mess up my purple and pink eyeshadow look. On my skin, it feels incredibly lightweight and refreshing. It lands in a fine, cooling mist that leaves no heavy or sticky residue.The glow factorIt's exactly what I am looking for. It has a beautiful shimmer that gives a radiant finish rather than that irritating, chunky glitter look. When I got some on my hands for close-up pictures, it washed right off with a simple hand soap rinse.The Scent ExperienceThe fragrance is where this mist truly stands out. It features a refreshing watermelon extract blended with kakadu plum, creating a sophisticated tropical profile. I will say in my opinion it's a sweet fruit" scent rather than an overly sweet candy fragrance. I will say, the feeling I get when I spray it on my skin is that I'm instantly transported somewhere tropical. One example would be like at a resort, having a watermelon slushie, and looking at the palm trees. It's an immediate mood booster. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the Golden Glow Shimmer Mist SPF50 for about a week now, mostly as the last step in my makeup routine, and I actually enjoy using it more than I expected. My skin still feels comfortable and not weighed down. It gives that smooth, glowy look without needing extra highlighter. I really liked it. I love SPF in a spray form. It's very convenient to apply during the day, over makeup. Very convenient format. I was already a big fan of the original Naked Sundays spf mist and now it comes with some shimmer and glow! This sunscreen is a great idea to protect from the sun while also having a beautiful glow. My skin is fair and I need all the sun protectant I can get. I used a lotion sunscreen then topped it off for additional protection with this naked sundays glitter mist. It protected me well on one of the first days of spring in direct sunshine all day. I glowed and my family commented on my glow. It really shines nice in direct sunshine and protects against sun damage and UV rays well. I didnt need to reapply. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.
